provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.bindings directly introduces shared.typing.bindings. Links environment, field-description, perm, base, typed Σ and Given binding behavior. Bind/Unpack introduce only the binding judgment. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. BindingTyped.variable preserves the value type in a fresh entry. unpack requires given permission, matching base/class declaration, a permutation of all declared fields, distinct fresh destination names and FieldBindings. The displayed declaration-order rule is equivalent under the stated reordering convention and transfers empty descriptions explicitly. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
